title: Inside Mirakl's agentic commerce vision
summary: Mirakl is redefining commerce through AI agents and ChatGPT Enterprise—achieving faster documentation, smarter customer support, and building toward agent-native commerce with Mirakl Nexus.
body: Mirakl is redefining commerce through AI agents and ChatGPT Enterprise—achieving faster documentation, smarter customer support, and building toward agent-native commerce with Mirakl Nexus.
summaryZh: Mirakl通过集成ChatGPT Enterprise和构建Mirakl Nexus平台，探索AI Agent在电商领域的应用。该方案旨在优化文档处理与客户支持，并推动向“Agent原生”电商模式转型。

aiReview.reasonZh: Mirakl展示了AI Agent在电商领域的应用场景，但缺乏具体技术细节。
